comments.text:
Welcome to Argentina! 🇦🇷 Where the minimum wage is 376,600 pesos a month — under $260.

Here's the catch: a small studio in Buenos Aires rents for about $323 — more than the entire paycheck, before food, before the bus, before anything. A cheap paradise for visitors paying in dollars... a monthly puzzle for the people who live here.

💬 Could YOU make $260 cover rent and food in Buenos Aires? Tell us where you're watching from!
